game_info.name: Crimson Desert
game_info.description: An open-world action-adventure set on the continent of Pywel, following Kliff and the Greymanes after a devastating ambush.

summary: The story follows Kliff after the Greymanes are devastated and scattered.
Kliff is trying to reunite the survivors, rebuild the Greymanes, and reclaim what was lost.
The Black Bears are a major hostile force in the opening setup.

official_bosses.name: White Horn
tips: Treat it like a reaction and spacing fight.
Watch the opening pattern before committing to offense.
Punish after larger recovery windows instead of attacking constantly.

official_bosses.name: Reed Devil
tips: Stay patient and avoid panic dodging.
Use short punish windows instead of long greedy combos.

official_bosses.name: Staglord
tips: Control stamina so you can still dodge after attacking.
Bait larger moves and answer during recovery.

official_bosses.name: Queen Stoneback Crab
tips: Look for safe windows instead of forcing damage.
Stay aware of area control and movement space.
Treat it like an endurance and positioning encounter.

official_bosses.name: Hexe Marie
tips: Stay composed and learn the rhythm before pushing damage.
Respect summon pressure and avoid overcommitting.
Use calm spacing and recovery punish opportunities.

combat: Short punish windows are often safer than long attack strings

advice: Prioritize survivability and consistency over risky burst damage.
Learn enemy patterns before chasing damage.
Use exploration to gather resources before hard encounters.
Start specializing your gear after you understand your combat rhythm.
Build around mobility, pressure, or durability instead of spreading too thin.
Refine your build around your preferred weapon and boss approach.
Use targeted preparation for specific encounters instead of generic setup.

response_policy: Use official_bosses and official_story_and_world as highest-confidence sources.
If answering with community_reference data, explicitly say it is community-sourced.
If a boss, quest, item, or system is not in the database, say that clearly instead of pretending certainty.
Use tactical action-game advice when exact facts are missing.
Prefer concise, practical answers unless the user asks for more detail.
